message: FINAL_DRAFT_APPROVED. Ten final_draft.md files, 20,871 words. Third review round resolved. Six rules/continuity defects fixed: the Chord's key restated as one note per Star (three- and four-Star teams could not sound five); Formation restricted to Stars who have both not yet acted, closing a double-action hole; Chapter 8's Miss list restructured so the clock tick or Shine loss is mandatory and the named Gloom move is the fiction carrying it, not an alternative to it; the three-player lineup corrected from Wren/Priya/Danny to Wren/Priya/Marisol, which is the trio that actually has the +2 coverage the text claims; and Chapter 10's Chorus no longer crosses into the Spectrum before the Bridge, since refracting and morphing are the same act. Three compile-phase verification steps in the plan were also corrected before use.
